CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING DIVISION
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING AGENDA
November 6, 2024, 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to
  address the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda
  other than a public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Minute(s) approval for October 2, 2024, Planning Commission
  meeting(s).

6.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A public hearing to consider an application by Michael
  Rocque for a Special Use Permit to amend certain conditions
  of approval to SP-2020-004 for an existing three-story
  hotel and restaurant on an approximately 86,102 square-
  foot, M-1L (Limited Manufacturing) zoned property at 3900
  West Century Boulevard.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the categorical exemption EA-CE-2024-126;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving SUP24-00019.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD
  CONDITIONS, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the
  request or any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the
  findings.
  Item 6a Documents

  b. A public hearing to consider Zoning Code Amendment No. 24-
  00001  (ZCA24-00001)  to  establish  Objective  Design
  Standards for Chapter 12 of the Inglewood Municipal Code.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the categorical exemption EA-CE-2024-114;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving ZCA24-00001.
   B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD
  CONDITIONS, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the
  request or any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the
  findings.
  Item 6b Documents

  c. A Public Hearing to consider Zoning Code Amendment No. 24-
  00002 (ZCA24-00002) to establish Inclusionary Zoning
  Regulations to Chapter 12 of the Inglewood Municipal Code.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the categorical exemption EA-CE-2024-115;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving ZCA24-00002.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD
  CONDITIONS, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the
  request or any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the
  findings.
  Item 6c Documents

7.  NON-PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A non-public hearing to consider an application by Brasa
  Capital Management, to construct Design Review to allow
  the construction of an 8-story mixed-use building
  consisting of 150 residential units, commercial/retail
  space and associated parking on an approximately 41,000
  square-foot H-C (Historic Core) zoned property at 111
  North La Brea Avenue.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2024-131;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving DR24-00058.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD
  CONDITIONS, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the
  request or any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the
  findings.
  Item 7a Documents

  2
   b.  A non-public hearing to consider an application by Kenrick
  Sanderlin, representing the City of Inglewood, to
  construct a new 437 square-foot restroom at Edward
  Vincent, Jr. Park.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2024-129;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving PCR24-00013.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD
  CONDITIONS, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the
  request or any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the
  findings.
  Item 7b Documents

8.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning
  Commission on any matter within their jurisdiction and not
  elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

9.  Commission Initiatives.

10.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations, due to a disability,
please contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One
Manchester Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall,
Inglewood, CA 90301. All requests for special accommodations must
be received 48 hours prior to the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor
de llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of November 6,
2024, is not held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or
other agenda item being considered, the public hearing or non-
public hearing agenda item will automatically be continued to the
next regular Planning Commission meeting.

  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
  WEDNESDAY, DECEMEBR 4, 2024, 7:00 P.M.
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS, NINTH FLOOR, INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  ONE MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301
